Priya (partnerships): Heads up — TidalHealth went GA on GCP Marketplace today and converted their pilot to a Dedicated contract. 3-year reserved capacity, VPC peering + HIPAA addendum signed. Huge win! :tada:
Ethan (solutions): Amazing!! Congrats team. Any notes on latency targets? Did they lock SLOs?
Priya (partnerships): Yes — 99.95% uptime, p95 120ms for standard chat endpoint (our tests). Dedicated pool sized for steady 150 req/s, burst to 600.
Sam (sales): Nicely done. Who's owning the customer case study + reference? We should lock a quote and request ROI numbers from them.
Leah (marketing): I'll draft a short launch post. Can we get a success metric and a 1-2 sentence customer quote? Priya, can you intro to their CSM?
Priya (partnerships): Intro sent to @leah-marketing and @sam-sales — thread email: tidal-csm@tidalhealth.com. CSM says they saw 3x inference cost reduction after we recommended batching + int8.
Ethan (solutions): Putting together a small technical checklist for the case study. Can you confirm model variants they run? Looks like med-lm-7b-quant and a cached embeddings route.
Priya (partnerships): Confirmed. Also asked for anonymized latency charts and a screenshot of the console billing view.
Sam (sales): I'll update SFDC opportunity with the dedicated contract details and attach the signed MSA.
Leah (marketing): Draft PR in drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1TidAl-GCP-Launch — please add comments by EOD Wednesday.
Priya (partnerships): Thanks everyone. Small follow-up: schedule a customer interview next week (Tue 10am PT suggested).
TidalHealth CSM Bot: Reminder: customer interview scheduled for 2025-11-25 10:00 PT — calendar invite sent.
Ethan (solutions): Great. Quick note for ops: enable canary route for fallback to hosted small-model variant for nights — ops, please ack.
Maya (eng-sre): acked. Setting up the route and alert thresholds.
Sam (sales): Big congrats team :rocket:
